create_SIREN_network: create a SIREN neural network with sine activations and uniform weight initialization for continuous representation learning
build_Basis_with_smearing: build a Basis module with powersine, fouriersine, gauss, or linact smearing to encode input features into higher dimensions
create_SphericalSmearing_harmonics: create a SphericalSmearing module to compute real-valued spherical harmonics from normalized 3D coordinate tensors
build_GaussianSmearing_embedding: build a GaussianSmearing module to embed input features using Gaussian basis functions across a configurable range
create_SINESmearing_fourier_features: create a SINESmearing or FourierSmearing module to generate sinusoidal or Fourier frequency embeddings from input features
